seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Matthews, NC 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Matthews, NC: Winter Wonderlights, The Nutcracker Ballet, photos with Santa and The Best Christmas Pageant Ever.
lede: Matthews celebrates Christmas with a town park lighting party, a Nutcracker ballet at the community center, Santa photos and a community theatre Christmas comedy.
celebrates: The Town of Matthews Parks, Recreation and Cultural Resources Department runs most of the town's holiday calendar. Winter Wonderlights at Stumptown Park on December 5 brings Santa, crafts, inflatables, stage performances and a park lighting, with a new Matthews Area Chamber of Commerce holiday market beside it. The Matthews Community Center hosts The Nutcracker Ballet on two weekends and a Photos with Santa morning on December 12, and Matthews Playhouse stages The Best Christmas Pageant Ever in the center's Fullwood Theatre from December 10 to 20.
lastyear: The Town of Matthews event pages still carry text from earlier seasons. The 2021 listing for Photos with Santa described breakfast with Santa and Mrs. Claus plus a take-home craft at the community center, and the 2021 Nutcracker listing named Matthews Ballet and Dance as presenter. We did not find a 2025 recap on a host page that we could verify, so check the town's event pages to see what has changed this year before you plan your day.
facts: The Matthews Playhouse says its Christmas Pageant is filled with local talent of all ages, and the show runs about two hours. The town's Nutcracker has six showings over two weekends at the Matthews Community Center, which opens its doors on Saturdays from 9 am to 2 pm and Sundays from 1 to 6 pm. New in 2026, the Matthews Area Chamber of Commerce is hosting a holiday market alongside Winter Wonderlights, and the town asks that no pets or outside alcohol come to special events.
trains: Matthews does not have a Christmas train ride of its own on our pages. The closest holiday train in our Charlotte guide is THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride at the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer, north of Charlotte, which is a longer trip than a typical Matthews outing. For a Christmas story closer to home, Matthews Playhouse's Christmas Pageant and the Nutcracker at the community center both tell classic holiday tales.
train_links: The museum in Spencer runs THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride in the Christmas season and is listed in our Charlotte guide.

kidfact: The Matthews Nutcracker has six showings, and Winter Wonderlights has a clown who twists balloons.
faq: When is Winter Wonderlights in Matthews in 2026?

The Town of Matthews holds Winter Wonderlights on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 3:30 to 6:30 pm at Stumptown Park. Santa makes an appearance for photos, and the park lighting ceremony starts at about 5:30 pm. The tree and park lights come on at about 6:30 pm. The town's page does not print a price.
Where can kids meet Santa in Matthews?

Santa appears at Winter Wonderlights on December 5 and sits for ticketed photos at the Matthews Community Center on December 12 in two sessions, Santa Claus at 9 am and Santa Paws at 11 am. Each event page on this guide lists the host's details and tickets.
Is there a Nutcracker in Matthews?

Yes. The Town of Matthews presents The Nutcracker Ballet at the Matthews Community Center, 100 McDowell Street, on November 28 at 2 and 7 pm, November 29 at 3 pm, December 5 at 2 and 7 pm and December 6 at 3 pm. The town's page does not print ticket prices.
What Christmas shows are at Matthews Playhouse?

Matthews Playhouse stages The Best Christmas Pageant Ever from December 10 to 20, 2026, in the Fullwood Theatre. It is recommended for all ages, runs about two hours and includes a Pay What You Can night on December 10 and several 2 pm matinees.
Is there a train ride near Matthews?

Matthews has no train ride listed on our pages. The N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer runs THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride and is the nearest holiday train in our Charlotte guide. Check the museum's own site for dates, times and tickets before you plan the trip.
